name: D1X-Rebirth
description:
D1X-Rebirth is an open-source source port of the classic six-degrees-of-freedom first-person shooter Descent. It upgrades the original 1995 Parallax Software title to run natively on modern operating systems with high-definition rendering.

Features:
- Full 6DoF (six degrees of freedom) zero-gravity movement and flight combat
- OpenGL hardware-accelerated rendering with arbitrary screen resolutions
- Modern gamepad, flight stick, and mouse-look control configuration
- Enhanced multiplayer networking supporting TCP/IP and UDP matches
- Full compatibility with the original Descent mission data and custom add-ons
